label: Typed tools over an engine
subgoals: Declare each tool's inputs and outputs as a schema
Return structured fields instead of raw logs
Describe preconditions in the tool description

label: Choosing tool granularity
subgoals: Expose coarse actions such as run a stage or report timing
Batch per-object operations into one call
Run long jobs asynchronously with a job id and a status tool

label: Sessions, sandboxing and structured results
subgoals: Hold the loaded database in a session between calls
Run the server on-site in a sandbox without outbound network
Make tools idempotent and log every call for replay
